title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
summary: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
summary: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.

title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
summary: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
summary: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
summary: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
summary: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
summary: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
summary: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
summary: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
summary: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.
